title: Bunkerhill Health and UTMB Health Advance Clinician-Led Agentic AI at Enterprise Scale
snippet:
--Bunkerhill Health today announced the system-wide deployment of its Carebricks platform at the University of Texas Medical Branch, enabling clinician-led, agentic AI workflows that support care delivery across a health system serving over one million patient visits annually.
